description: Build a factor from SEC filings for a list of tickers, monthly from start to end, using only what had been filed by each date (restatements invisible until filed). Writes a signal CSV for backtest_signal. Values are what companies reported to the SEC in XBRL, as filed by each date; a company that files late, files outside XBRL or changes its tags can be missing.

factor.description: One of roa, gross_margin, operating_margin, revenue_growth, asset_growth, accruals, or level:<measure> (revenue, net_income, assets, ...).

out_file.description: Where to write the signal CSV; default a new temporary file.

tickers.description: Tickers (or CIKs) to compute it for.

name: pit_factor
title: Build a point-in-time factor
